resources.string: Block app installation from unknown sources
Android enforces this block even for sources previously allowed. Android 10+ covers all users; Android 8 and 9 cover the current user. Trusted stores and ADB are not blocked.
Block applied and confirmed by Android.
Automatic blocking requires Device Owner mode. Ordinary device administrator and accessibility access are not enough. Review permissions manually or open the setup guide below.
Android could not confirm the change or current protection. Try again.
Active: unknown sources blocked across the device.
Active: unknown sources blocked for the current user only.

Before enabling, you can open Android settings and turn off “Allow from this source” for each app. Android does not let FocusGuard reset all these individual switches automatically. The system block overrides them while active; previously allowed sources may work again after disabling it.
Could not open the system page. Open Settings → Security → Install unknown apps manually.
Disabling allows installation from unknown sources again, according to each app’s existing permission.
